get_current_user.title: Get the authenticated user
get_current_user.description: Read the Bitbucket account the token belongs to: uuid, account_id, display name and nickname. The cheapest health check for a Bitbucket connection, and the way to find your own uuid for reviewer lists. For email addresses use list_current_user_emails.

list_current_user_emails.title: List my email addresses
list_current_user_emails.description: List every email address on the authenticated user's account, with which one is primary and which are confirmed. Needs the `email` scope, which get_current_user does not.

output.description: A page of email addresses. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with email, is_primary and is_confirmed.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: Read another Bitbucket user's public profile by account id or uuid: display name, nickname and avatar. Location, website and created_on are omitted when the profile is private.

selected_user.description: The user's account_id, or uuid in braces, e.g. "{d301aafa-d676-4ee0-88be-962be7417567}".

list_ssh_keys.title: List a user's SSH keys
list_ssh_keys.description: List the SSH public keys on a user account (pass the authenticated user's uuid or account_id). Returns each key's uuid, label, fingerprint and expiry; use the uuid with delete_ssh_key.

selected_user.description: The user's account_id or uuid in braces; normally the authenticated user.

output.description: A page of SSH keys. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with uuid, key, label, fingerprint, created_on and expires_on.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

add_ssh_key.title: Add an SSH key to a user
add_ssh_key.description: Add an SSH public key (OpenSSH format) to a user account so it can push and pull over SSH. Returns the stored key with its uuid and fingerprint. For a key scoped to one repository use add_deploy_key instead.

selected_user.description: The user's account_id or uuid in braces; normally the authenticated user.

key.description: The public key, e.g. "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3Nz... user@host".

label.description: A label to recognise the key by.

expires_on.description: When the key should expire, ISO 8601, e.g. "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z".

delete_ssh_key.title: Delete a user's SSH key
delete_ssh_key.description: Remove an SSH key from a user account. Anything authenticating with that key loses access immediately; this cannot be undone.

selected_user.description: The user's account_id or uuid in braces.

list_workspaces.title: List my workspaces
list_workspaces.description: List the workspaces the authenticated user can access, each with whether the user administers it. The starting point for finding the workspace slug every other tool takes.

administrator.description: Only workspaces the user administers (true) or does not (false).

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. "-updated_on".

output.description: A page of workspace accesses. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with administrator and a workspace object holding slug, name and uuid.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

get_workspace.title: Get a workspace
get_workspace.description: Read one workspace's name, slug, uuid and privacy. Use list_workspaces to discover slugs.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

get_my_workspace_permission.title: Get my role in a workspace
get_my_workspace_permission.description: Read the authenticated user's role in one workspace: owner or member. Cheaper than list_workspace_permissions when you only need your own access.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

list_workspace_members.title: List workspace members
list_workspace_members.description: List the users who are members of a workspace. Workspace admins can filter by email with query 'user.email IN ("a@x.com")'. For each member's role use list_workspace_permissions.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

query.description: Filter expression; admins may filter by user.email.

output.description: A page of memberships. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with a user object (uuid, account_id, display_name).

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_workspace_permissions.title: List workspace member roles
list_workspace_permissions.description: List every member of a workspace with their permission level (owner or member). Filter with query 'permission="owner"' to find the admins.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

output.description: A page of workspace memberships. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with permission and user.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_workspace_repository_permissions.title: List repository permissions across a workspace
list_workspace_repository_permissions.description: List who has which permission (read, write, admin) on every repository in a workspace, or on one repository when repo_slug is given. Filter with e.g. 'permission="admin"' or 'user.account_id="..."'.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Limit to one repository slug. Defaults to every repository.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. "-updated_on".

output.description: A page of repository permissions. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with permission, user and repository.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_user_pull_requests.title: List a user's pull requests across a workspace
list_user_pull_requests.description: List pull requests authored by one user across every repository in a workspace. Only open ones by default; pass state for merged, declined or superseded. For one repository use list_pull_requests.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

selected_user.description: The author's account_id or uuid in braces.

page_size.description: How many pull requests per page (1-50).

output.description: A page of pull requests. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with id, title, state, source, destination and destination.repository.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

search_code.title: Search code in a workspace
search_code.description: Search file contents and paths across every repository in a workspace, using the same syntax as the Bitbucket UI (e.g. 'initClient repo:api lang:python'). Returns matching files with highlighted line matches. Code search must be enabled for the workspace; Atlassian has announced this endpoint's deprecation for 1 November 2026.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

output.description: A page of code search results. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with file (path, commit), content_matches and path_matches.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_projects.title: List projects in a workspace
list_projects.description: List the projects in a workspace, with their keys. Every repository belongs to a project; pass project_key to create_repository to choose one.

output.description: A page of projects. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with key, uuid, name, description and is_private.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

get_project.title: Get a project
get_project.description: Read one project by key: name, description, privacy and links to its repositories.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

update_project.description: Change a project's name, description, privacy or key. Only the fields you pass are changed. Returns the updated project.

delete_project.title: Delete a project

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

list_project_default_reviewers.title: List a project's default reviewers
list_project_default_reviewers.description: List the users added automatically as reviewers to new pull requests in every repository of a project. For one repository's effective list use list_effective_default_reviewers.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

output.description: A page of default reviewers. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with user and reviewer_type.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

add_project_default_reviewer.title: Add a project default reviewer
add_project_default_reviewer.description: Add a user to a project's default reviewers, so they are requested on every new pull request in its repositories. Idempotent.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

selected_user.description: The user's account_id or uuid in braces.

remove_project_default_reviewer.title: Remove a project default reviewer
remove_project_default_reviewer.description: Remove a user from a project's default reviewers. Pull requests already open keep their reviewers.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

selected_user.description: The user's account_id or uuid in braces.

list_repositories.title: List a workspace's repositories
list_repositories.description: List the repositories in a workspace, with the slugs every other tool takes. Filter with a BBQL query (e.g. 'project.key = "MARS"' or 'name ~ "api"') and by the caller's role.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

create_repository.title: Create a repository

is_private.description: Whether the repository is private. Defaults to private.

update_repository.description: Change a repository's name, description, privacy, language, fork policy, main branch or project. Only the fields you pass change. Renaming also changes the slug, so later calls must use the new one.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

redirect_to.description: URL the old repository location should redirect to.

list_forks.title: List a repository's forks
list_forks.description: List the forks of a repository, with their workspace and slug.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. "-updated_on".

output.description: A page of repositories. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each fork, with full_name and parent.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

fork_repository.title: Fork a repository
fork_repository.description: Fork a repository into a workspace. Forking into the same workspace needs a new name. Returns the new fork; it may take a moment before its contents are available.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

list_watchers.title: List a repository's watchers

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

output.description: A page of users. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with uuid, display_name and account_id.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_repository_user_permissions.title: List explicit user permissions on a repository
list_repository_user_permissions.description: List users granted explicit permission (read, write or admin) directly on a repository, excluding access inherited from the workspace or project. For effective access use list_workspace_repository_permissions.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

output.description: A page of user permissions. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with permission and user.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_repository_group_permissions.title: List explicit group permissions on a repository
list_repository_group_permissions.description: List workspace groups granted explicit permission (read, write or admin) directly on a repository.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

output.description: A page of group permissions. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with permission and group (slug, name).

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_branch_restrictions.title: List branch restrictions
list_branch_restrictions.description: List a repository's branch permission and merge-check rules, optionally only of one kind or matching one pattern.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

pattern.description: Only rules for this branch pattern.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

get_branch_restriction.description: Read one branch restriction rule by id: its kind, pattern, value and allowed users and groups.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

id.description: The branch restriction's id, from list_branch_restrictions.

create_branch_restriction.title: Create a branch restriction
create_branch_restriction.description: Protect branches: restrict pushes, deletes or force-pushes, or add merge checks such as minimum approvals or passing builds. For push and restrict_merges, only the listed users and groups keep the right (empty means nobody). Returns the rule with its id.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

kind.description: What to restrict, e.g. push, delete, force, require_approvals_to_merge, require_passing_builds_to_merge.

user_uuids.description: For push/restrict_merges: uuids of users still allowed.

group_slugs.description: For push/restrict_merges: slugs of groups still allowed.

update_branch_restriction.title: Update a branch restriction
update_branch_restriction.description: Change an existing branch restriction rule's kind, pattern, value or allowed users and groups. Only passed fields change.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

id.description: The branch restriction's id, from list_branch_restrictions.

kind.description: What to restrict, e.g. push, delete, force, require_approvals_to_merge, require_passing_builds_to_merge.

branch_match_kind.description: Match branches by glob `pattern` or by branching-model `branch_type`.

value.description: Number for kinds that take one, e.g. minimum approvals for require_approvals_to_merge.

user_uuids.description: For push/restrict_merges: uuids of users still allowed.

group_slugs.description: For push/restrict_merges: slugs of groups still allowed.

delete_branch_restriction.description: Delete a branch restriction rule, lifting that protection from the matching branches.

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

id.description: The branch restriction's id, from list_branch_restrictions.

get_file.title: Read a file from a repository
get_file.description: Read a file's raw contents at a branch, tag or commit. Returns the bytes as text, not JSON. For a directory listing use list_directory; for size and type without the contents use get_file_metadata.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

file_path.description: Path to the file in the repository.

list_directory.title: List a directory
list_directory.description: List the files and subdirectories of a directory at a branch, tag or commit; leave path empty for the repository root. max_depth recurses into subdirectories. Each entry says whether it is a commit_file or commit_directory.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

path.description: Directory path, e.g. "src/utils". Empty for the root.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. "-updated_on".

output.description: A page of directory entries. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with type (commit_file or commit_directory), path, size and mimetype.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

get_file_metadata.title: Get a file's metadata
get_file_metadata.description: Read a file's or directory's metadata at a revision instead of its contents: type, size, mimetype, attributes (e.g. executable, lfs) and the commit.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

commit_files.title: Commit file changes
commit_files.description: Create a commit that adds or overwrites text files (and optionally deletes one path), without a git client. Each file is {"path": "docs/a.md", "content": "..."}. Commits onto the main branch unless branch is given; a new branch name creates that branch. Returns an empty 201 on success; the new commit is the branch's head.
commit_files.notes: Sent as application/x-www-form-urlencoded, which the endpoint accepts alongside multipart; binary files need multipart and are not supported here.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

files.description: Files to write, each {"path": "<repo path>", "content": "<full text>"}.

branch.description: Branch to commit to; created if it does not exist. Defaults to the main branch.

author.description: Author as 'Name <email>'. Defaults to the authenticated user.

parent.description: Commit hash the new commit should build on, to guard against concurrent changes.

delete_path.description: A path to delete in this commit (Bitbucket's `files` field).

output.description: Empty on success (HTTP 201); the Location header names the new commit.

list_file_history.title: List a file's history
list_file_history.description: List the commits that changed one file, newest first, following renames by default. Like `git log --follow <path>`.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

repo_slug.description: Repository slug (or UUID in braces), as returned by list_repositories.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to start from.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. "-updated_on".

output.description: A page of file history entries. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with path, size and commit.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

create_workspace_webhook.description: Subscribe a URL to events on a workspace. Needs the `webhook` scope plus read access to what the events concern (e.g. `pullrequest` for pull request events). Returns the webhook with its uuid.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

url.description: HTTPS URL events are POSTed to; must be publicly routable.

events.description: Events to deliver, e.g. ["repo:push", "pullrequest:created", "pullrequest:fulfilled"]. See list_webhook_event_types.

secret.description: Shared secret; Bitbucket signs deliveries with it in X-Hub-Signature.

update_workspace_webhook.title: Update a workspace webhook
update_workspace_webhook.description: Change a webhook on a workspace: its url, events, description, secret or whether it is active.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

uid.description: The webhook's uuid in braces, from the list tool.

url.description: HTTPS URL events are POSTed to; must be publicly routable.

events.description: Events to deliver, e.g. ["repo:push", "pullrequest:created", "pullrequest:fulfilled"]. See list_webhook_event_types.

secret.description: Shared secret; Bitbucket signs deliveries with it in X-Hub-Signature.

delete_workspace_webhook.title: Delete a workspace webhook
delete_workspace_webhook.description: Delete a webhook on a workspace; its endpoint stops receiving events.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

uid.description: The webhook's uuid in braces, from the list tool.

list_webhook_event_types.title: List webhook event types
list_webhook_event_types.description: List the event names a repository or workspace webhook can subscribe to (e.g. repo:push, pullrequest:approved), with descriptions.

output.description: A page of event types. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with event, category, label and description.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

list_snippets.title: List snippets
list_snippets.description: List the snippets in a workspace that the caller can see, optionally only those they own, contribute to or are a member of.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

role.description: Only snippets where the caller has this role.

output.description: A page of snippets. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with id, title, is_private, owner and created_on.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

size.description: Total matching items, when Bitbucket counts them.

get_snippet.title: Get a snippet
get_snippet.description: Read a snippet's metadata and file list. Read a file's contents with get_snippet_file.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

get_snippet_file.title: Read a snippet file
get_snippet_file.description: Read the raw contents of one file in a snippet at its latest revision.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

path.description: The file's name within the snippet.

update_snippet.title: Update a snippet's details
update_snippet.description: Change a snippet's title or privacy. Changing file contents needs a multipart upload, which this tool does not do.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

delete_snippet.title: Delete a snippet
delete_snippet.description: Permanently delete a snippet and its history.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or UUID (in braces), e.g. "acme".

list_snippet_comments.title: List a snippet's comments
list_snippet_comments.description: List the comments on a snippet, oldest first, with author and text.

output.description: A page of comments. Pass page+1 to continue while `next` is present.

values.description: Each with id, content.raw, user and created_on.

next.description: URL of the next page; absent on the last page.
